# Kanye Concierge 360

> Licensed REALTOR® practice serving buyers and sellers at every price point across Greater San Antonio, Bexar County and the Texas Hill Country (Boerne, New Braunfels, Helotes, Schertz, Cibolo and more). Call or text 830-699-6542.

Kanye Concierge 360 is led by a licensed REALTOR® with an MBA in Business Marketing and more than 15 years of corporate leadership at Delta Air Lines, managing portfolios of $340M+. It helps first-time buyers, military and veteran families at Joint Base San Antonio, move-up buyers, luxury and ranch buyers, and home sellers.

## San Antonio buyer and seller guides (2026, with cited sources)
- [The Cheapest Places to Buy a House in San Antonio Right Now (2026)](https://kanyeconcierge360.com/cheapest-places-to-buy-a-house-in-san-antonio-2026.html): The most affordable San Antonio ZIP codes and suburbs in 2026, from under $150,000 to $350,000, with typical home values, what to check before you buy, and down payment help.
- [First-Time Home Buyer in San Antonio? Here's the Down Payment Help Most People Miss (2026)](https://kanyeconcierge360.com/first-time-home-buyer-san-antonio-down-payment-assistance-2026.html): Every major down payment assistance program for San Antonio buyers in 2026: City of San Antonio HIP, TDHCA My First Texas Home, TSAHC Homes for Texas Heroes, with amounts and limits.
- [San Antonio's Million-Dollar Neighborhoods: Where the Top of the Market Lives (2026)](https://kanyeconcierge360.com/million-dollar-neighborhoods-san-antonio-2026.html): Hill Country Village, The Dominion, Shavano Park, Terrell Hills, Olmos Park and Alamo Heights: typical values, school districts and what to know before you buy or sell at the top of the San Antonio market.
- [San Antonio Housing Market: The September 2026 Numbers, Explained](https://kanyeconcierge360.com/san-antonio-housing-market-september-2026.html): San Antonio's September 2026 housing numbers: median price $302,999, 88 days on market, 5.95 months of inventory. What it means for buyers and sellers, in plain English.
- [San Antonio Property Taxes in 2026: The $140,000 Exemption and What You'll Really Pay](https://kanyeconcierge360.com/san-antonio-property-taxes-2026-homestead-exemption.html): Texas raised the school homestead exemption to $140,000 and the over-65 exemption by $60,000. Here are San Antonio's tax rates by school district and how to file with Bexar Appraisal District.
- [Selling Your House in San Antonio in 2026: What It's Worth, How Long It Takes, What Changed](https://kanyeconcierge360.com/sell-your-house-san-antonio-2026.html): San Antonio homes now average 88 days on market and sell for 92.4% of original list price. Here's how to price right, what the 2026 Texas rules mean for sellers, and what to disclose.
- [Military City Home Buying: VA Loans and Veteran Programs in San Antonio (2026)](https://kanyeconcierge360.com/va-loan-military-home-buyers-san-antonio-2026.html): Stationed at Joint Base San Antonio or retiring here? VA loan basics for 2026, the funding fee, the Texas Veterans Land Board loan, and down payment help for heroes.
- [$250K, $450K or $1 Million: What Your Money Buys in San Antonio in 2026](https://kanyeconcierge360.com/what-your-money-buys-in-san-antonio-2026.html): Where every budget lands in San Antonio in 2026: the neighborhoods and suburbs at $250,000, $450,000 and $1 million, with typical values and yearly property taxes.
